unit_of_analysis: One physical teaching branch at one current address. Different locations of the same brand/chain count as separate branches. Several subjects or levels taught at one address remain one branch with multiple branch_offerings records.
in_scope: Physical Singapore tuition branches (a specific, identifiable teaching address).
Mathematics tuition overlapping at least one P1-S4 level (P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, S1, S2, S3, S4).
Multi-subject or hybrid academic centres, if mathematics and an overlapping P1-S4 level are supported by evidence at that specific branch.
out_of_scope: Online-only providers with no identifiable physical teaching branch.
Individual home tutors without an identifiable teaching centre.
Pure enrichment providers with no documented academic mathematics offering.
Closed or future (not-yet-opened) branches at the analysis cutoff.
A brand headquarters or registered address that is not itself evidenced as a teaching location.

level_tokens.note: A branch confirmed for S5/JC/A-level/IB only, with no P1-S4 evidence, is excluded. A branch confirmed for both a P1-S4 level and an out-of-scope level remains in scope on the P1-S4 evidence alone; the out-of-scope levels are recorded but not counted as the qualifying evidence.

subject_tokens.note: Token match is necessary but not sufficient; evidence_status still requires the source/evidence-scope rules below, not a keyword match alone.

evidence_statuses.confirmed: All three hold: (1) a current official operator-controlled source supports the physical branch address and current branch existence; (2) official operator-controlled subject/programme/timetable evidence supports mathematics; (3) official evidence supports at least one overlapping P1-S4 level.
evidence_statuses.possible: Credible evidence of a physical branch and likely in-scope offering exists, but at least one confirmation element from the confirmed rule is absent, generic, stale (older than the evidence freshness window) or contradictory.
evidence_statuses.excluded: Evidence affirmatively places the branch outside scope (e.g. explicitly online-only, explicitly closed, explicitly preschool/adult-only, explicitly no mathematics or no P1-S4 level).
evidence_statuses.unresolved: Identity, address or status conflicts prevent classification into any of the above (e.g. two sources disagree on whether the branch is still operating, or on its exact address/unit).

evidence_scope_definitions.operator_controlled: A page or document published and controlled by the branch's own operator (its own domain/official page, official centre-locator, official social-media business page it controls, or an operator-issued document). This is the only evidence scope that can satisfy the confirmed rule's address/subject/level elements.
evidence_scope_definitions.directory: A third-party aggregator/directory listing (e.g. S010) not controlled by the operator. Directory-only evidence can support possible at most, never confirmed, per the explicit rule that a directory result, ACRA registration, search snippet or map pin alone must never create a confirmed branch.
evidence_scope_definitions.legal_entity: ACRA or another company/business registry record (S011). Corroborates legal identity/registration status only; never proves an operating teaching branch at a given address by itself.
evidence_scope_definitions.search_snippet: A general web-search result snippet, used only to locate an operator-controlled page to validate against; never stored or cited as evidence content itself once the operator page has been checked.

evidence_freshness_days.note: Mirrors the foundation/methodology-wide 30-day dynamic-evidence refresh rule already adopted for branch/offering/premises evidence.

double_counting_guards: A brand total is never substituted for a branch count; every reported count is of physical branches unless explicitly labelled a brand count.
A relocation creates a new branch record linked to the previous one via previous_branch_id; only the current operating site counts as 'current' at the analysis cutoff.
Multiple subjects/levels at one address remain one branch with multiple branch_offerings rows, never multiple branch rows.
A directory listing and an operator page describing the same physical branch resolve to one branch record with two evidence_observations rows, never two branches.
